content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the master ignoring incoming offers in trickle ICE mode due to a lack of proper session management. Specifically, the previous implementation did not correctly handle the scenario where a new offer was received while a session was still active, leading to the new offer being ignored. The patch introduced a mechanism to track whether an SDP offer/answer exchange had already occurred using an atomic boolean flag (`sdpOfferAnswerExchanged`), ensuring that new offers are processed correctly even if they arrive while a session is active. Additionally, the viewer sample was modified to generate a random client ID each time, which helps prevent conflicts with existing sessions.

buggy_stmts_infos.buggy_stmt: -                DLOGD("session still active, ignore new offer that has the same client id");
